scope: Actual native-picked lip point, actual both-hand vertices, source rigid props and actual finite 12mm lid/source-body triangle intersections, sampled through six seconds at the explicitly reported interval. Positive support uses source skin vertices and the actual carton-bottom geometry (4mm contact tolerance), excluding rigid nails/bangles. Texture bindings stripped only in memory; no native appearance/FPS acceptance. Interior is 3mm inside the real lid edge; full plane and solid-volume contacts are also retained.
